visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man wearing a tight white tank top and loose black trousers stands on a city sidewalk. He faces a brightly decorated punch machine with a red punching bag. He delivers a strong punch with his gloved right hand, then watches the digital score counter climb rapidly while resetting his stance. Background buildings and colorful commercial signs are visible under natural daylight. (2) A younger man dressed in a casual black t-shirt and grey athletic shorts approaches the punch machine. He takes a focused stance and strikes the bag with a swift, technical punching motion. After seeing his high score of 802 appear in large red text, he excitedly celebrates with a group of friends who are nearby, raising his fists in victory. (3) A large, powerful man in a dark grey t-shirt and black pants steps toward the machine. He throws a heavy-impact punch that causes the bag to recoil significantly. The screen displays a record score of 974, and he walks away calmly with a confident posture while the surrounding onlookers react with visible surprise and gestures.
